Figure 7A

readcount_matrix_SAA <- read.table("data/SAA1_readcount_matrix.txt",header = T,row.names = 1,sep = "\t")
readcount_matrix_SAA <- as.matrix(readcount_matrix_SAA)


readcount_matrix_SAA <- readcount_matrix_SAA[grep("^CATG|^ENSG", rownames(readcount_matrix_SAA), invert = TRUE),]

readcount_matrix_SAA_RPM <- readcount_matrix_SAA / colSums(readcount_matrix_SAA) * 1e6

meta_SAA <- data.frame(condition = c(rep("SAA",1), rep("SAA", 1), rep("CON",1), rep("CON", 1), rep("CON",1), rep("SAA", 1)),
                       patient = factor(c(rep("235",1), rep("237", 1), rep("238",1), rep("235", 1), rep("237",1), rep("238", 1))),
                       row.names = colnames(readcount_matrix_SAA))

meta_SAA$condition[meta_SAA$condition=="CON"] <- "control"
meta_SAA$condition[meta_SAA$condition=="SAA"] <- "SAA"

meta_SAA$condition <- factor(meta_SAA$condition, levels = c("control", "SAA"))

all(colnames(readcount_matrix_SAA) == rownames(meta_SAA))  # 必须为 TRUE
## [1] TRUE
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = readcount_matrix_SAA,
                              colData   = meta_SAA,
                              design    = ~ patient + condition)


dds <- DESeq(dds)

dds <- dds[ rowMeans(counts(dds)) > 5, ] #remove zeros (added to Jiawei's code)



resLFC <- lfcShrink(dds, coef="condition_SAA_vs_control", type="normal")

res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "SAA", "control"))


res_df_SAA <- data.frame(res)
res_df_SAA <- data.frame(resLFC)
res_df_SAA$gene <- rownames(res_df_SAA)
res_df_SAA <- res_df_SAA[!is.na(res_df_SAA$log2FoldChange),]
res_df_SAA <- res_df_SAA[order(res_df_SAA$log2FoldChange, decreasing = TRUE),]


a <- bitr(geneID = res_df_SAA$gene,fromType = "SYMBOL",toType = "ENTREZID",OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
a <- data.frame(a)
a <- a[!duplicated(a$SYMBOL),]
a$gene <- a$SYMBOL

res_df_SAA_new <- merge(res_df_SAA, a, by = "gene")
res_df_SAA_new <- res_df_SAA_new[!is.na(res_df_SAA_new$ENTREZID),]

ddd <- res_df_SAA_new$log2FoldChange
names(ddd) <- res_df_SAA_new$ENTREZID
ddd <- sort(ddd,decreasing = T)
set.seed(100)
dd <- gseKEGG(geneList = ddd, organism = "hsa",verbose = T, use_internal_data = F,eps = 0,seed = F, pvalueCutoff = 1, pAdjustMethod = "BH")
dd <- data.frame(dd)

gsekegg_all_SAA <- dd



### LPS

readcount_matrix_LPS <- read.table("data/LPS_readcount_matrix.txt",header = T,row.names = 1,sep = "\t")
readcount_matrix_LPS <- readcount_matrix_LPS[grep("^CATG|^ENSG", rownames(readcount_matrix_LPS), invert = TRUE),]

readcount_matrix_LPS_RPM <- readcount_matrix_LPS / colSums(readcount_matrix_LPS) * 1e6

meta_LPS <- data.frame(condition = colnames(readcount_matrix_LPS) %>% strsplit("_") %>% lapply(function(x) x[2]) %>% unlist(),
                       patient = colnames(readcount_matrix_LPS) %>% strsplit("_") %>% lapply(function(x) x[1]) %>% unlist(),
                       row.names = colnames(readcount_matrix_LPS))

meta_LPS$condition[meta_LPS$condition=="CON"] <- "control"
meta_LPS$condition[meta_LPS$condition=="LPS"] <- "LPS"

meta_LPS$condition <- factor(meta_LPS$condition, levels = c("control", "LPS"))

all(colnames(readcount_matrix_LPS) == rownames(meta_LPS))  # need to be TRUE
## [1] TRUE
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = readcount_matrix_LPS,
                              colData   = meta_LPS,
                              design    = ~ condition)


dds <- DESeq(dds)

dds <- dds[ rowMeans(counts(dds)) > 5, ] #remove zeros (added to Jiawei's code)

resLFC <- lfcShrink(dds, coef="condition_LPS_vs_control", type="normal")

res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "LPS", "control"))

res_df_LPS <- data.frame(res)
res_df_LPS <- data.frame(resLFC)
res_df_LPS$gene <- rownames(res_df_LPS)
res_df_LPS <- res_df_LPS[!is.na(res_df_LPS$log2FoldChange),]
res_df_LPS <- res_df_LPS[order(res_df_LPS$log2FoldChange, decreasing = TRUE),]


a <- bitr(geneID = res_df_LPS$gene,fromType = "SYMBOL",toType = "ENTREZID",OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
a <- data.frame(a)
a <- a[!duplicated(a$SYMBOL),]
a$gene <- a$SYMBOL

res_df_LPS_new <- merge(res_df_LPS, a, by = "gene")
res_df_LPS_new <- res_df_LPS_new[!is.na(res_df_LPS_new$ENTREZID),]

ddd <- res_df_LPS_new$log2FoldChange
names(ddd) <- res_df_LPS_new$ENTREZID
ddd <- sort(ddd,decreasing = T)
set.seed(100)
dd <- gseKEGG(geneList = ddd, organism = "hsa",verbose = T, use_internal_data = F,eps = 0,seed = F, pvalueCutoff = 1, pAdjustMethod = "BH")
dd <- data.frame(dd)
gsekegg_all_LPS <- dd


gsekegg_all_LPS_temp <- gsekegg_all_LPS[gsekegg_all_LPS$p.adjust < 0.05 & gsekegg_all_LPS$NES > 0, ]
gsekegg_all_LPS_temp <- gsekegg_all_LPS_temp[order(gsekegg_all_LPS_temp$NES, decreasing = TRUE),]


gsekegg_all_SAA_temp <- gsekegg_all_SAA[gsekegg_all_SAA$p.adjust < 0.05 & gsekegg_all_SAA$NES > 0, ]
gsekegg_all_SAA_temp <- gsekegg_all_SAA_temp[order(gsekegg_all_SAA_temp$NES, decreasing = TRUE),]

gse_all <- rbind(gsekegg_all_SAA_temp, gsekegg_all_LPS_temp)
gse_all$group <- c(rep("SAA1", nrow(gsekegg_all_SAA_temp)),
                   rep("LPS", nrow(gsekegg_all_LPS_temp)))
gse_all$neg_log10_adj_p <- -log10(gse_all$p.adjust)
gse_all$Description <- factor(gse_all$Description, levels = c(gse_all$Description[gse_all$Description %in% names(table(gse_all$Description)[table(gse_all$Description)>1])] %>% unique(),
                                                              gsekegg_all_SAA_temp[!gsekegg_all_SAA_temp$Description %in% names(table(gse_all$Description)[table(gse_all$Description)>1]),]$Description,
                                                              gsekegg_all_LPS_temp[!gsekegg_all_LPS_temp$Description %in% names(table(gse_all$Description)[table(gse_all$Description)>1]),]$Description %>% rev()
) %>% rev()
)
gse_all$group <- factor(gse_all$group, levels = c("SAA1", "LPS"))

gse_all <- gse_all[gse_all$Description %in% c(names(table(gse_all$Description)[table(gse_all$Description)>1]),
                                              "Rheumatoid arthritis",
                                              "Viral protein interaction with cytokine and cytokine receptor",
                                              "Fructose and mannose metabolism",
                                              "Arginine and proline metabolism",
                                              "Tryptophan metabolism",
                                              "TNF signaling pathway",
                                              "Biosynthesis of cofactors",
                                              "Toll-like receptor signaling pathway",
                                              "Thermogenesis",
                                              "ECM-receptor interaction",
                                              "PPAR signaling pathway",
                                              "Retinol metabolism",
                                              "Drug metabolism - cytochrome P450",
                                              "Oxidative phosphorylation"
                                              ),]

p <- ggplot(gse_all, aes(x = group, y = Description)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = NES, size = neg_log10_adj_p)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 10)) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(n = 7, name ="PRGn"))(51)[30:51]) +  # 可根据需要调整颜色梯度
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),legend.position = "right") +
  labs(x = "item", 
       y = "group", 
       color = "NES", 
       size = "neg Log10 P")

p

Figure 7C

DEG_SAA1 <- res_df_SAA
DEG_SAA1 <- DEG_SAA1[!is.na(DEG_SAA1$padj),]
DEG_SAA1 <- DEG_SAA1[!is.na(DEG_SAA1$log2FoldChange) ,]
DEG_SAA1 <- DEG_SAA1[order(DEG_SAA1$log2FoldChange, decreasing = TRUE), ]

DEG_LPS <- res_df_LPS
DEG_LPS <- DEG_LPS[!is.na(DEG_LPS$padj),]
DEG_LPS <- DEG_LPS[!is.na(DEG_LPS$log2FoldChange) ,]
DEG_LPS <- DEG_LPS[order(DEG_LPS$log2FoldChange, decreasing = TRUE), ]

depots_snRNAseq <- readRDS("data/depots_snSeq1.RDS")
depots_snRNAseq <- NormalizeData(depots_snRNAseq)
depots_snRNAseq <- ScaleData(depots_snRNAseq)

depots_snRNAseq <- subset(depots_snRNAseq, celltype_low %in% c("C01", "C02", "C04", "C05", "C06", "C07", "C08", "C09", "C10", "C13", "C14"))


depots_snRNAseq <- AddModuleScore(depots_snRNAseq, features = list(intersect(DEG_SAA1[DEG_SAA1$log2FoldChange>1 & DEG_SAA1$padj<0.05,]$gene, rownames(depots_snRNAseq@assays$RNA@counts))), name="DEG_SAA",assay = "RNA") 
depots_snRNAseq <- AddModuleScore(depots_snRNAseq, features = list(intersect(DEG_LPS$gene[1:450], rownames(depots_snRNAseq@assays$RNA@counts))), name="DEG_LPS",assay = "RNA") 


df <- FetchData(depots_snRNAseq, vars = c("DEG_SAA1", "DEG_LPS1", "UMAP_1", "UMAP_2", "cellclass"))
df$cellclass[df$cellclass=="mesothelial"] <- "FAP"
df$cellclass[df$cellclass=="FAP"] <- "ASPC"

p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, color = DEG_SAA1)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma", limits = c(-0.05, 0.1), oob = scales::squish) +
  theme_void() +
  coord_fixed() + 
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, color = DEG_LPS1)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.1) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma", limits = c(-0.05, 0.1), oob = scales::squish) +
  theme_void() +
  coord_fixed() + 
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

df$cellclass <- factor(df$cellclass, levels = c("myeloid","lymphoid","vascular","ASPC"))


p3 <- ggviolin(df, x = "cellclass", y = "DEG_SAA1", fill = "cellclass",
         add = "boxplot", add.params = list(fill = "white")) + rotate() + NoLegend() + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

df$cellclass <- factor(df$cellclass, levels = c("ASPC", "vascular", "myeloid", "lymphoid"))


p4 <- ggviolin(df, x = "cellclass", y = "DEG_LPS1", fill = "cellclass",
         add = "boxplot", add.params = list(fill = "white")) + rotate() + NoLegend() + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

ggarrange(p1, p3, p2, p4, ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
